subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction use the same aborted assistant tool-call drop policy as the prompt-send sanitizer before summarization?
rationale: The patch is technically focused and well proven, but it changes session-state semantics by dropping aborted tool-call turns during compaction instead of preserving or synthesizing context.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge as-is, accepting small context loss for interrupted assistant tool-call turns to prevent strict providers from permanently rejecting the session.

options.title: Preserve or synthesize interrupted context
options.body: Ask for a revised policy that keeps recoverable context for aborted turns, with tests proving strict-provider validity and no misleading tool result semantics.

options.title: Pause this fix
options.body: Hold the PR until a broader session-recovery policy is chosen, leaving the linked compaction failure unfixed on main.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge as-is, accepting small context loss for interrupted assistant tool-call turns to prevent strict providers from permanently rejecting the session.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision turns on the transcript repair policy that steipete most clearly owns in current history.
